job.job_description:
AI Engineer Fresher


Location: Bengaluru | Chennai | Hyderabad
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: Freshers (2023–2026 Pass-Outs)


About the Role


Are you fascinated by Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and the technologies shaping the future?


We are looking for innovative and passionate individuals to join our team as AI Engineers. This opportunity is ideal for fresh graduates who want to build a career in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and intelligent automation.


As an AI Engineer, you will work on cutting-edge AI solutions, contribute to the development of intelligent applications, and gain hands-on experience with modern AI technologies. If you're excited about solving complex problems and building the next generation of intelligent systems, this role can be the perfect start to your career.


Key Responsibilities


Assist in developing and implementing AI-powered solutions.

Work with datasets for model training and analysis.

Support machine learning model development and optimization.

Develop prompts and workflows for Generative AI applications.

Collaborate with technical teams to build intelligent automation solutions.

Analyze model performance and recommend improvements.

Research emerging AI technologies and industry trends.

Participate in AI experimentation, testing, and deployment activities.


Required Skills


Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Basic understanding of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts.

Knowledge of Python programming fundamentals.

Understanding of data structures and algorithms.

Strong logical reasoning and critical thinking skills.

Good communication and collaboration abilities.

Passion for learning emerging technologies.


Preferred Skills


Python

Machine Learning Fundamentals

Generative AI

Prompt Engineering

Deep Learning Basics

Data Analysis

NLP Fundamentals

AI Frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch – Basic)


Candidates without prior experience in these technologies may still apply if they demonstrate strong aptitude, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.


Eligibility


Candidates with a Bachelor's or Master's degree from a recognized institution are eligible to apply. Fresh graduates and recent pass-outs from the 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026 batches are welcome.


Applicants from Engineering, Technology, Computer Applications, Science, Commerce, Management, Arts, and other academic backgrounds may apply. Selection will be based on skills, aptitude, problem-solving ability, and role suitability.


What We're Looking For


Passion for Artificial Intelligence and innovation.

Strong logical and analytical thinking.

Curiosity and eagerness to explore new technologies.

Positive attitude and growth mindset.

Ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing technologies.

Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.


Work Location


Selected candidates will be deployed at one of our locations in:


Bengaluru
Chennai
Hyderabad


Candidates should be willing to relocate based on business requirements.


Why Join Us?


Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI and emerging technologies.

Exposure to real-world AI applications and business use cases.

Structured learning and career development opportunities.

Collaborative and innovation-driven work environment.

Strong foundation for building a successful career in Artificial Intelligence.


How to Apply


Send your updated resume to:
fresher.hiring@mockwin.ai


Subject Line: AI Engineer – Fresher Application


Stay Connected

Start Your Career in Artificial Intelligence


If you're ready to explore the future of technology, build intelligent solutions, and create real-world impact through AI, we'd love to hear from you.
